classification: prospective design assumptions; source panels synthetic, not observed OTP

quality.scope: all assigned cases or explicit whole deliverable act

flow.unit: accepted unique root standard units / independent prospective available capacity standard units
flow.FTE: scheduled_hours already contains FTE; never multiply again
flow.full_assignment_constraint: all independently assigned due roots retained including unfinished; strong each stratum >=1.00; normal each>=0.90
flow.rank: descending result ratio quantized to0.0001; ties exact after quantization; QA only gate

project.config: unique business-config v1 by group/period/work_type approved before effort; no implicit v2
project.workflow_normal: all assigned accepted/released roots meet type-specific prospective target and independent mature use; full QA
project.workflow_strong: minimum usage/target across assigned roots>=1.10; no multiplication by child count
project.workflow_rank: descending minimum local target attainment only within same type, target basis, comparable capacity
project.analytical_normal: one named business decision used checked accepted/released package by committee business_deadline; usage=1, whole scope QA
project.analytical_strong: normal plus acceptance and release at or before ready_by pre-read deadline, justified by scheduled validation cycle
project.analytical_rank: all strong tie; no extra benefit from earlier than pre-read; never110% of binary1
project.different_types: pre-register distinct local home pools, allocate150R per unique registered participant; no bare usage comparison

authorization: performed personal and for project team source-review: exact period:beneficiary, independent whole-team actors and timestamp>=quality-close. Award-review separately after close; exact signed package/version/amount binding. Missing/stale signature holds U while calculated rights, conditional reserve and fixed window remain.
tie: tie spans occupied fixed slots; sum amounts divided equally across tie; team share applied once; floor integer R per person, residue unissued
guarantee: both first quarters of same fixed annual window; one G/12months, no rolling retry. No FTE reduction after sufficient exposure
missing: pending/known-gap not_computable; retain original conditional ceiling and proven right, source loss never zero performance
calendar: actual [personal quarter start00:00,next_start00:00); QA fact finalized<=quality_close_at inclusive; late delivery of timely fact restores original window; R4 boundary probes insufficient for full award and lack business config

authorization_contract.source_review: source_completeness_review for personal scope; projects also require team scope with beneficiary_team exact
authorization_contract.noncyclic: exclude award audit acts and approvals_audit source-manifest from signed material; still verify their physical counts/SHA separately
authorization_contract.idempotency: stable person:period:top and person:fixedwindow:G; current U is a state, never sum repeat evaluations; no real posting performed
